entities.summary: Niranjan Iyengar born in Dombivali, Maharashtra, India, is a screenwriter and lyricist particularly known for his work with director Karan Johar. He is also author of the book, The Making of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham.... He also hosts the talk show Look Who's Talking with Niranjan, which is aired on Zee Café.
